<thought>To obtain the precursors, I need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to deprotecting a tert‑butyldimethylsilyl (TBS) ether to give an aliphatic alcohol. I will search the template catalog for a reaction that breaks a “t‑butyldimethylsilyl” group and forms an “aliphatic hydroxyls” group. Then I will apply the found template to the supplied molecule to get all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
